title: Recover Buffer-Compile Files
summary: Restores any file left holding unsaved-buffer content after a Compile Buffer (unsaved) run was interrupted (for example by a crash)
intro: Read this if a Compile Buffer (unsaved) run was interrupted, for example by a crash. It restores any file left holding the unsaved-buffer content so no unit keeps overlaid text instead of its saved original; the IDE can run it for you.

surfaces.caption: Recover Buffer-Compile Files
steps: Nothing to click in the normal case; the IDE runs it for you
To run it by hand: `drag-lint ghost-recover "<project>"`
It prints "ghost-recover: nothing pending." when there is nothing to restore

questions.ask: The IDE crashed during Compile Buffer (unsaved); is a unit left with the wrong text?
